pr_title: Fix scheduler issue with nodetree additions
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**
 /kind bug

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

When adding multiple nodes to the scheduler nodetree, the function getting the next node does not return all the nodes one after an other, but skips some and duplicate others. This commit works around the problem by always starting with reset counters.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes #91601 

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:

```release-note
Fixed node data lost in kube-scheduler for clusters with imbalance on number of nodes across zones
```

/sig scheduling
/kind bug


	nodesToAdd:     append(allNodes[5:9], allNodes[3]),

	expectedOutput: []string{"node-6", "node-7", "node-3", "node-8", "node-6", "node-7"},
},
